answer: A beacon on a rocky ledge guards an agent economy with a spiral of endorsements: every new identity must gather distinct endorsements from established agents, one more than the last, so the first fake needs 2 endorsers, the second 3, the third 4, the tenth 11 and the twentieth 21, and twenty fakes together need 230 distinct endorsers. Bulk farming fails because each established agent may endorse only one newcomer per epoch and endorsements cannot be transferred or bought, so a farmer must persuade 230 separate honest agents, like a climber who needs a guide for every turn of the stairs.
